description: This file defines the IActivationRebalancer interface, which provides methods for interacting with an activation rebalancer component in Orleans. It includes methods for obtaining rebalancing reports, controlling rebalancing operations, and managing report listeners.

classes.name: IActivationRebalancer
classes.description: Interface for interacting with the activation rebalancer, providing methods to get reports, control rebalancing, and manage report listeners.

methods.name: GetRebalancingReport
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current rebalancing report, with an option to force an immediate update.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Suspends the activation rebalancing process for an optional duration.

methods.name: SubscribeToReports
methods.description: Subscribes a listener to receive rebalancer reports.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromReports
methods.description: Unsubscribes a listener from receiving rebalancer reports.
